reason: A dsh plugin that fixes DeepSeek Harness Web UI connectivity on plain-HTTP LAN origins by injecting a conditional crypto.randomUUID polyfill into served pages.

summaries.zh: 通过向网页注入条件式 crypto.randomUUID poly填充，为纯 HTTP 局域网地址修复 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的连接问题。
summaries.en: Fixes DeepSeek Harness Web UI connectivity on plain-HTTP LAN addresses by injecting a conditional crypto.randomUUID polyfill into served pages.

capabilities: Injects an inline JavaScript polyfill into served index.html responses
Modifies browser-side crypto.randomUUID behavior when unavailable
Registers a web server index transformation hook
